data_objects.name: individual_insurance_charge_records
data_objects.meaning: Individual insurance-charge records with demographic, body-mass, dependent-child, smoking, and regional attributes.
data_objects.notes: The table has no explicit record identifier or documented monetary unit.

variables.name: age
variables.meaning: Age of the person associated with the record.

variables.name: sex
variables.meaning: Recorded sex category, encoded as lowercase female or male.

variables.name: bmi
variables.meaning: Body mass index of the person.

variables.name: children
variables.meaning: Number of children or dependents associated with the insurance record.

variables.name: smoker
variables.meaning: Whether the person is recorded as a smoker, encoded as yes or no.

variables.name: region
variables.meaning: Broad region associated with the record, encoded as northeast, northwest, southeast, or southwest.

variables.name: charges
variables.meaning: Recorded insurance-related charge amount for the individual record.

structure.description: Each row represents one individual insurance record; no source column is an explicit row identifier, and no semantic row ordering is declared.
sex, smoker, and region are categorical fields, while age, bmi, children, and charges are numeric fields.

uncertainties: The evidence does not establish the currency of charges or whether that amount is billed, allowed, paid, or otherwise defined.
The precise scope of children and the geographic system represented by region are not documented.
annotation_notes: Semantics are grounded only in train.csv and its declared packet.
